scope: Regular and Italic; Russian, Kazakh and inherited Latin

decisions.item: Italic constructed letters lack mark anchors; add native-compatible anchors.
Regular homoglyph GLIF roundtrip loses hint programs; clone declared native glyphs.
Italic zhe counters shortened by up to 48 units per bowl; gaps 45 to 32; no uniform scaling.
Keep the author-selected rounded Cormorant-derived Regular de, and its printed ss07 alternative.
No claim of complete Bulgarian/Serbian/Ukrainian support; language expansion and small caps remain separate work.
Both styles share a release version; internal italic drawing revision remains I027.
Regular de bowl and width retained; smooth displacement below -10 shortens loop -280 to -250; printed ss07 unchanged.
Additional kern/calt lookups must ignore combining marks; stress-word spacing regression added.
Add Bulgarian stressed i characters Ѝ/ѝ without claiming full local-form review.

Remove visible notches in italic ж and upper shoulder kink of з. ж: remove k branch stubs; redraw clean stem with native weight; correct bowl shoulder tangent. з: outgoing handle y487 to489; contour deviation ~1 unit. Per-glyph assertions and enlarged proof.
Default italic г: exact native dotlessi body from locl SRB imacron, without uni0304. Preserve SRB/MKD macron and printed ss04; retain previous construction source and 1.100 archive.
Italic ғ derives from the selected default г body with a merged crossbar at y236–266, fitted overhangs, advance 288 and shared mark anchors.

Italic д was clipped at y0, leaving a 74-unit chord. Restore the native q bowl overshoot at -9; preserve accepted advance 432 through a spacing override. Descender profile deviation at most 0.7 units.
Italic я lower bowl was nine units at its hairline. Deepen the native g bowl clipping ellipse to yield 15 units, preserve advance 413 and keep the junction smooth.

Remove the remaining visible donor seams in italic я: replace the top g-bowl/q-stem notch and lower link/stem triangular spur with tangent-matched quadratic splines; preserve bowl, counter, advance 413 and bearings.
Regular я: replace both sharp leg-to-bowl shoulders with compact tangent-matched quadratic curves; preserve advance 428, bearing -6, bounds, bowl, terminals and overall proportions.
Regular я: remove the remaining kink on the inner left edge of the right foot by making its adjacent quadratic controls exactly collinear; preserve all metrics and bounds.
